title: TraceQA common types
description: Types shared by more than one contract.

Viewport.description: Size of the browser window content area, in CSS pixels. Each side is 1 to 10000.

Rect.description: A rectangle in CSS pixels. Inside a RawElement it is relative to that frame's document. Everywhere else it is relative to the top-level page.

BrowserTarget.description: Which browser to run in. The engine passes this to a driver and never interprets it.

browser.description: Browser name. Known values: chromium, chrome, msedge, firefox, webkit, safari, cdp, webdriver.

cdpEndpoint.description: WebSocket or HTTP endpoint of an already running browser. Used with browser = cdp.

webdriverUrl.description: URL of a W3C WebDriver server, local or a cloud grid. Used with browser = webdriver.

webdriverCapabilities.description: Capabilities to ask the WebDriver server for, for example { "browserName": "safari" }.

BrowserInfo.description: What actually ran, as reported by the driver.

StorageState.description: Cookies and stored values to start a browser with, so it is already signed in or past a site's first screen. The same format as Playwright's storageState, so a file made by Playwright can be used. It holds session keys: treat it as a password. The engine never writes it to a run folder or an event.

domain.description: For example example.com, or .example.com for its subdomains too.

expires.description: Unix time in seconds. -1 or absent for a cookie that lasts until the browser closes.

origin.description: Scheme, host and port, for example https://app.example.com.

Warning.description: Something that did not stop the run but that the reader should know.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code. Known values: cross_origin_frame_skipped, unnamed_interactive_element, scroll_limit_reached, frame_eval_failed, screenshot_failed, browsers_disagree, viewport_not_reached, http_error_status, page_load_incomplete, covered_elements, closed_shadow_roots, elements_removed_while_scrolling, session_not_accepted, signed_in_pictures, collector_tampered, requests_failed.

ElementState.description: State of one element at the moment it was read.

visible.description: False when the element is hidden by CSS (display, visibility, opacity, content-visibility), has no size, is clipped to one pixel or less, or is inside a hidden ancestor.

covered.description: True when another element lies on top of this one at every point tested, so a click would not reach it, as under a cookie banner or a modal's backdrop. Only tested for visible elements in the viewport; absent means it was not tested.

coveredBy.description: A selector for the element on top, when covered is true.

Confidence.description: How sure we are that an element is interactive. Low means it only looks clickable (for example a div with a pointer cursor).

LocatorStrategy.description: How a locator finds its component: by ARIA role and name, by test id, by visible text, or (last resort) by a CSS selector.

LocatorScope.description: One ancestor a locator searches inside, outermost first in Locator.scope.

name.description: The ancestor's accessible name, matched exactly.

Locator.description: How to find a component again with Playwright-style locators (getByRole, getByTestId, getByText). The counts are over the instances collected in the same file, so uniqueness is proven for one page in one browser; `traceqa codegen` combines the files of all browsers. Never uses nth(): a component that cannot be told apart is reported as not unique, or located by CSS with forced set.

role.description: ARIA role, for the role strategy.

name.description: Accessible name (role strategy) or text (text strategy). Matched exactly: whitespace normalised, case sensitive. Absent when the name is a template or changes.

exact.description: True whenever a name is used.

testId.description: Value of data-testid, for the testid strategy.

scope.description: Ancestors to search inside, outermost first, each a descendant of the one before.

frame.description: Label of the frame the component is in, as written in its path: lower case, whitespace normalised. Absent for the main frame.

css.description: CSS selector, only for the css strategy.

unique.description: True when the locator matches the component's instances and nothing else collected (matches equals own).

matches.description: How many collected instances in this file the locator matches.

own.description: How many of those are instances of this component.

ambiguousWith.description: Ids of other components the locator also matches, at most 5.

forced.description: True when no readable locator told the component apart and a structural CSS selector was used. Brittle: it breaks when the page layout changes.

needsIncludeHidden.description: True when every instance is hidden, so a role locator only finds it with includeHidden.
